```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(extrafont)
library(cowplot)
library(car)
library(lme4)
library(effectsize)
```
```{r}
# function to define the B3 lab theme
theme_B3 <- function () { 
  theme_classic() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),  # remove major gridlines
      panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),  # remove minor gridlines
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"), # center & bold
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold") # center & bold 
    )
}
```
```{r figure out working directory}
getwd()
```

```{r get datasets together}
day4 <- read.csv("/Users/AprilBooth/Desktop/Dissertation/Chapter2_cropmilk/R_markdowns/parent_weight_d4.csv")
day1 <- read.csv("/Users/AprilBooth/Desktop/Dissertation/Chapter2_cropmilk/R_markdowns/parent_weight_d1.csv")
data_w <- full_join(day4, day1, by = "sample")
```
```{r get nest info in order}
key <- read.csv("/Users/AprilBooth/Desktop/Dissertation/keys/parent_key.csv")
data_w <- full_join(data_w, key, by = c("sample"))
data_w <- na.omit(data_w)
```

```{r get difference in weight from d1 to d4}
data_w$d <- data_w$weight_d4-data_w$weight_d1
```
```{r get categories for analysis}
data_w$treatment <- as.character(data_w$treatment)
data_w$treatment[data_w$treatment == "single female"] <- "single mother"
data_w$treatment[data_w$treatment == "single male"] <- "single father"
data_w$treatment[data_w$treatment == "paired female"] <- "paired mother"
data_w$treatment[data_w$treatment == "paired male"] <- "paired father"
#get sex category
data_w$sex[data_w$treatment == "single mother"] <- "female"
data_w$sex[data_w$treatment == "single father"] <- "male"
data_w$sex[data_w$treatment == "paired mother"] <- "female"
data_w$sex[data_w$treatment == "paired father"] <- "male"
#get nest type category
data_w$type[data_w$treatment == "single mother"] <- "single parent"
data_w$type[data_w$treatment == "single father"] <- "single parent"
data_w$type[data_w$treatment == "paired mother"] <- "paired parent"
data_w$type[data_w$treatment == "paired father"] <- "paired parent"
```


##Graphing data to see how it looks:
```{r}
adult_weight <- ggplot(aes(y = d, x = treatment, fill=treatment), data = data_w) + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + scale_fill_manual(values = colors_parent) +
  labs(title = "Difference in parent weight", x="", y="difference in parent weight (grams)") + geom_point(pch = 21, position = position_jitterdodge()) + theme_B3() + scale_x_discrete(limits=c("paired mother","paired father", "single mother", "single father")) + theme(text=element_text(family="", size=18)) +theme(axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black",family="", size = 18)) + theme(legend.position = "none")
adult_weight
```
#now do ANOVA analysis
```{r}
leveneTest(d ~ treatment, data = data_w, center = mean)
```
```{r}
leveneTest(d ~ brood, data = data_w, center = mean)
```
# so parametric ok
```{r}
lmer_p <- lmer(d ~ treatment+brood+(1 | nestid), data = data_w, REML = TRUE)
Anova(lmer_p, type = "II", test = "F")
```

# so no significant difference in adult bird weight across treatment groups.
```{r eta}
eta_squared(Anova(lmer_p, type = "II", test = "F"))
```
## how about by nest type or sex?
```{r}
leveneTest(d ~ type, data = data_w, center = mean)
```
```{r}
leveneTest(d ~ sex, data = data_w, center = mean)
```
# so parametric ok
```{r}
fit_ws <- aov(d ~ type*sex, data = data_w)
Anova(fit_ws, type = "II")
```
```{r}
eta_squared(Anova(fit_ws, type = "II"))
```
